checked_claims.note: Under ATT-0066/(H3) on reduced B_k, I_k≅P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) is Zariski-locally trivial. For irreducible Y⊂B_k, a dense trivializing open U gives U×P^{k−1} irreducible and dense in the preimage, so P((π_*L|_Y)^∨) is irreducible; preimages of distinct base components are closed, cover I_k, and are incomparable by image, hence exactly the irreducible components. Dimension dim(Y)+k−1 is the standard projective-bundle formula and matches FND-0121’s relative form; the statement is indexed by components of B_k, so the non-finite-type jump pathology does not apply.

ATT-0066/(H4) supplies a stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor tilde-I→I^dist. Restricting to connected normal locally Noetherian V⊂I^dist, the Galois category identifies connected components with π_1^ét(V)-orbits on the fibre. Right torsor trivialization makes monodromy act by left multiplication through H_V=im(ρ_V) (up to conjugacy); left H_V-orbits on S_6 are left cosets, hence number [S_6:H_V] and size |H_V|. Connected+normal ⇒ irreducible on the base; finite étale preserves normality, so connected components of the cover are irreducible. Each maps finite étale of degree |H_V| onto V and has dimension dim(V).
Immediate specialization of CLM-0082-2: [S_6:H_V]=720⇔|H_V|=1⇔H_V trivial; [S_6:H_V]=1⇔H_V=S_6⇔a single irreducible component. Neither extreme follows from the mere existence of the S_6-torsor.

theorem_statement: Component-and-monodromy test for the balanced tetragonal incidence. Assume the fibrewise balanced genus-6 degree-4 Casnati–Ekedahl hypotheses and the weak relative-canonical normalization carried by ATT-0066. Let B_3 and B_4 be the h0(L)=3 and h0(L)=4 strata, let I be the global degree-six Abel–Jacobi incidence, and assume each B_k is reduced, locally Noetherian, and finite-dimensional. For k in {3,4}, the projection I_k:=I×_B B_k→B_k induces a bijection between irreducible components: an irreducible component Y⊂B_k corresponds to P((π_*L|_Y)^∨), which has dimension dim(Y)+k−1. Now let V be any connected normal locally Noetherian substack of I^dist, and let H_V⊂S_6 be the image, defined up to conjugacy, of the étale monodromy representation on a geometric fibre of the finite étale S_6-torsor tilde-I_V→V. Then tilde-I_V has exactly [S_6:H_V] irreducible components; every component maps finite étale of degree |H_V| to V and has dimension dim(V). Consequently tilde-I_V has 720 irreducible components exactly when H_V is trivial, and it is irreducible exactly when H_V=S_6.
